source='''def transform(grid):
    """Place the grid and its rotations in a 2x2 arrangement."""
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*g[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*g)][::-1]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]
    return [g[i] + cw[i] for i in range(len(g))] + [ccw[i] + half[i] for i in range(len(g))]
'''
